### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Traverse backwards from an output node in a computation graph to discover all contributing parent nodes and directed edges.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
def autograd_l02_trace_reachable_graph(graph: dict, root_id: str) -> dict:
    reachable = set()
    edges = []
    def dfs(nid):
        if nid in reachable:
            return
        reachable.add(nid)
        for p in graph.get(nid, {}).get('parents', []):
            edges.append([p, nid])
            dfs(p)
    dfs(root_id)
    return {'nodes': sorted(list(reachable)), 'edges': edges}
```
